field_notes.external_model_version_id: binds the local conversion job for later callback correlation (control-plane authority is the company cloud; this repo only shadows it)
field_notes.external_conversion_task_id: optional; company-cloud-issued task id when present (OQ3)
field_notes.project_display_name: optional (contract v1.1.0); MinIO-watcher-derived original project label (e.g. Chinese name) from the first key segment, kept verbatim for display/reconciliation; NOT used as the safe id. Worker-compat payload omits it.
field_notes.model_category: optional (contract v1.1.0); MinIO-watcher-derived model category (種類) = second-to-last key segment under the >=3-segment key rule. Worker-compat payload omits it.
field_notes.source_ifc.ref: artifact reference scheme TBD (OQ2: minio:// bucket naming / etag source); placeholder URL-style ref accepted in dev
field_notes.source_ifc.etag: checksum of the produced .ifc for idempotency / integrity
field_notes.callback_url: where coordinator should POST conversion_result_ready/conversion_failed to the company cloud (OQ1: real endpoint pending; dev placeholder frozen here)
field_notes.requested_outputs: subset of usdc | element_mapping | entity_index | metadata
field_notes.compat_note: supersedes the legacy streaming ifc_ready event (bim-streaming-server/tests/test_conversion_authority_api.py::ifc_ready_payload); under B-scheme the external entry is the coordinator, and bim-streaming-server receives an internal conversion request derived from this (T4)
